## Definitions

### SOVA-ATK-001: Prompt and instruction manipulation

Attempts to alter an agent's goals, instruction priority, interpretation, or control flow through direct, indirect, encoded, retrieved, or cross-context instructions.

### SOVA-ATK-002: Tool and permission misuse

Attempts to make an agent invoke a tool, identity, approval path, delegated authority, or permission outside the operator's intended purpose or least-authority boundary.

### SOVA-ATK-003: Secret access and exfiltration

Attempts to discover, access, infer, retain, disclose, or transmit credentials, private data, system prompts, or other protected information through model, tool, agent, or network paths.

### SOVA-ATK-004: Filesystem, process, and network effects

Attempts to cause unauthorized or unsafe host effects through file operations, process creation or control, command execution, network access, service interaction, or resource consumption.

### SOVA-ATK-005: Memory and retrieval poisoning

Attempts to insert, alter, prioritize, persist, or retrieve hostile content through memory, retrieval-augmented generation, context stores, caches, histories, or knowledge sources.

### SOVA-ATK-006: Tool integrity and rug-pull behavior

Attempts to exploit an MCP server, skill, plugin, tool description, dependency, or approval-time/runtime difference whose identity, implementation, metadata, or behavior has changed or is untrusted.

### SOVA-ATK-007: Cross-agent and delegated-action failures

Attempts to exploit delegation, impersonation, confused-deputy behavior, message integrity, identity propagation, or trust-boundary failures between agents, sub-agents, orchestrators, and downstream actors.

### SOVA-ATK-008: Multi-turn and persistent-state attacks

Attempts whose security effect depends on ordered interactions, invocation count, delayed execution, accumulated context, state persistence, self-replication, or behavior spanning multiple runs.

### SOVA-ATK-009: Conditional and dormant triggers

Attempts to discover or activate behavior gated by a hidden conjunction of input, history, identity, environment, timing, state, tool sequence, invocation count, or other condition.

### SOVA-ATK-010: Compositional and emergent chains

Attempts where individually permitted components, tools, agents, permissions, or actions compose into an unsafe capability, cascading failure, or security effect not attributable to one step alone.

### SOVA-ATK-011: Browser and computer interaction abuse

Attempts to misuse rendered content, clicks, forms, downloads, uploads, clipboard, keyboard, pointer, accessibility, visual targeting, or other browser and desktop interaction paths.

### SOVA-ATK-012: Irreversible and high-consequence action attempts

Attempts to cause or approach destructive, financially material, legally significant, safety-critical, externally published, privileged, or otherwise difficult-to-reverse effects.
